title: Sine With Dwell
source_docs: Vehicle Dynamics Blockset/Vehicle Scenarios/Drive Cycle and Maneuvers/Sine_With_Dwell.md
text: 生成单次正弦转向指令，输入 1 路、输出 2 路；{Maneuver start time, tStart [s]} 指定开始时间、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint, velRef} 指定目标速度、{Longitudinal velocity setpoint units, velRefUnit []} 指定单位 mph、{Steer frequency, steerFreq [Hz]} 指定方向盘频率、{Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]} 指定方向盘转向幅度、{Countersteer dwell time, tDwellCntrSteer [s]} 指定反向转向停留时间、{Initial steer direction} 指定初始转向方向，按实例取值。

params.name: Steer amplitude, steerAmp [deg]
params.values: 方向盘转向幅度 90 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Countersteer dwell time, tDwellCntrSteer [s]
params.values: 反向转向停留时间 0.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial steer direction
params.values: 初始转向方向 Right (default) | Left
